title: cl-tmat: locked-protocol benchmark of adaptive groundwater-table forecasting in tropical peatlands
description: Code, locked configuration, run logs, results, and figures for a benchmark of static, periodically retrained, and continual-learning groundwater-table forecasts against persistence at eight tropical peatland stations in Indonesia (2018-2019), including the 2019 El Nino drought. The raw groundwater data (Taufik et al., 2022, Data in Brief 41:107903) are not redistributed.
